title: v5.2.0 — Notifications Actually Work Now
message: Notifications were broken — they only fired when the app was backgrounded, so you never saw them. Now they appear as a top-center toast in-app too. The permission prompt asks on first tap so you don't have to dig through settings. New: 5-minute background check warns you when someone passes you on the leaderboard. Service worker cache trimmed — only caches local files now, not all the CDN scripts. APK can't do true OS push (added to Known Issues honestly), but the in-app toast covers the experience while the app is open.
